name: Necromancer Infest on the action bar is saved as Virulency (#5469)
contract: AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp:99-104 (Virulency): a successful Virulency 801938 on a target carrying the Necromancer's diseases casts Infestation 803782, learns Infest 803781 with learnSpell(803781, true) (PLAYERSPELL_TEMPORARY, never written to character_spell) and calls SetTemporarySpellReplacement(801938, 803781). The replacement ends when Infestation is spent or removed (AscensionNecromancerAbilities.cpp:74, AscensionNecromancerAuras.cpp:228). A button holding Infest 803781 was saved by Player::_SaveActions as 803781; Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before any Virulency learns it again, so IsActionButtonDataValid would refuse and delete it. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes: the Infest button must be saved as Virulency 801938, and an ordinary known spell (Flesh to Worms 500338) must be saved unchanged. Fixture copied from necromancer-creeping-plagues-infest.json.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the source carries Flesh to Worms
The Infest button is saved as Virulency
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
